sources.snippet: The SO‑101 is the next‑generation version of the SO‑100 robot arm, originally designed by the RobotStudio in collaboration with Hugging Face. It has improved wiring, is easier to assemble (no gear removal) and uses updated motors for the leader arm. These arms are designed to work seamlessly with the open‑source 🤗 LeRobot library. sources.title: Pushpakcc/gr00t-so100_dualcam-finetuned · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a finetuned version of NVIDIA's GR00T-N1.5-3B foundation model, specifically adapted for SO-101 robot arm table cleanup tasks. The model has been trained on a custom dataset of 80 episodes (47,513 frames) demonstrating table cleanup behaviors using dual-camera observations.

sources.title: Simulation Models | TheRobotStudio/SO-ARM100 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Simulation Models Relevant source files This page provides an overview of the virtual robot models available for the SO-ARM100 robot system. The repository includes both URDF and MuJoCo (MJCF) format models to support different simulation, visualization, and AI control workflows.
